current_role: Mayor of New York City (since January 1, 2026)
summary: Zohran Mamdani, a democratic socialist state assemblyman, won New York City's 2025 mayoral race with the backing of Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez and Bernie Sanders, and was sworn in on January 1, 2026, as the city's first Muslim mayor. Michael Bloomberg spent heavily against him.

connections.name: Ken Griffin
connections.description: On April 15, 2026 Mamdani posted a video naming Griffin's $238 million penthouse to promote a new pied-à-terre tax; Griffin called it a "personal attack" that put him "in harm's way", and Citadel said it was reassessing its planned $6 billion Park Avenue headquarters tower. Mamdani refused to apologize.

connections.name: AIPAC
connections.description: In 2025 the National Black Empowerment Action Fund said it would spend $1.3 million against the DSA agenda in New York's mayoral race. Wikipedia says AIPAC helped fund the group; news reports reviewed confirm only that its founder, Darius Jones, is an AIPAC alumnus.
